550:t_1:255.en:
$$サックス$$
(Like Sergeant $$相良$$, I can't think of Al as just a machine anymore, either...)

550:t_1:256.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「All hands, fall in!」

550:t_1:259.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「The objective of this operation is to use the $$マクロス・クォーター$$ as a decoy while a force centered on this ship retakes $$メリダ島$$, which $$アマルガム$$ has occupied.」

550:t_1:260.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「You have already been briefed on the outline. Now Captain $$テスタロッサ$$, the officer in charge of the operation, will address you.」

550:t_1:263.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「Then, Captain... If you would.」

550:t_1:266.en:
$$テッサ$$
(...This battle may well be the last one for me and the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$...)

550:t_1:267.en:
$$テッサ$$
(If $$レナード$$'s plan is carried out, there's a chance that the very existence of $c could vanish from the world...)

550:t_1:268.en:
$$テッサ$$
(...I have no time to indulge in sentiment or anxiety. Neither the world nor I do...)

550:t_1:269.en:
$$テッサ$$
(Get it together. Straighten your back, tuck in your chin... don't let your eyes wander.)

550:t_1:270.en:
$$テッサ$$
(I am a leader brimming with talent and strength... the Witch of $$ミスリル$$, who has broken through every hardship and kept tormenting the enemy.)

550:t_1:271.en:
$$テッサ$$
(If I look down on them composedly, as always, and show a figure full of perfect dignity, then the anxiety and fear within them will...)

550:t_1:274.en:
$$テッサ$$
(I've done it now... And this might be my last address, too...)

550:t_1:275.en:
$$テッサ$$
(No matter how much I wanted to see everyone's faces, choosing the hangar was a mistake...)

550:t_1:276.en:
$$テッサ$$
(From now on, I'll make every piece of equipment in the hangar cordless, keep the floor perfectly flat so there's nothing to trip on...)

550:t_1:277.en:
$$テッサ$$
(...What am I thinking?! Calm down, hurry and recover your dignity...)

550:t_1:278.en:
$$テッサ$$
(Don't show any agitation. Stay perfectly calm, and make it look like you did it on purpose... Who falls on purpose, normally?!)

550:t_1:281.en:
$n
(Don't just dump every troublesome thing on me like that. It's Captain $$テスタロッサ$$ we're talking about, so that's $$宗介$$'s job.)

550:t_1:283.en:
$$マオ$$
(Better not. This is where $$テッサ$$ gets to show her caliber.)

550:t_1:284.en:
$$テッサ$$
(Quickly... quickly...! I have to do something...!)

550:t_1:285.en:
$$テッサ$$
(A way to recover my dignity, a way to recover my dignity, a way to recover my dignity...)

550:t_1:286.en:
$$テッサ$$
(...There isn't one. No such way exists.)

550:t_1:287.en:
$$テッサ$$
(Everyone must be appalled. Look... they're all standing at attention with blank faces.)

550:t_1:292.en:
$$テッサ$$
(What is this... these smiles... Nobody is even trying to hide their laughter...)

550:t_1:293.en:
$$テッサ$$
(Are they holding back their voices as some last act of courtesy...?)

550:t_1:295.en:
$$テッサ$$
(...I'm such a fool... Believing I was carrying the world alone, and acting tragic all by myself...)

550:t_1:296.en:
$$テッサ$$
(The fighting and the world will go on... together with these dear comrades.)

550:t_1:298.en:
$$マオ$$
(That's right. We've gotten through plenty of pinches like this one.)

550:t_1:299.en:
$$マオ$$
(So all you have to do is do what you always do. Yes... just like always...)

550:t_1:301.en:
$$テッサ$$
「I'm sorry for showing you such an ill-omened sight before the operation begins.」

550:t_1:303.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「If anything, I'd like to thank you for showing us something so entertaining.」

550:t_1:306.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「We are awaiting the Captain's words.」

550:t_1:308.en:
$$テッサ$$
「As already communicated, $$アマルガム$$, now the private organization of $$レナード・テスタロッサ$$, intends to trigger a $$時空震動|lc$$ on $$メリダ島$$...」

550:t_1:309.en:
$$テッサ$$
「and remake this world into the form he desires.」

550:t_1:312.en:
$$テッサ$$
「I can't truly feel the distorted world he speaks of.」

550:t_1:313.en:
$$テッサ$$
「At the very least, the world that exists here and now is the world we live in.」

550:t_1:314.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Up to this day there has been sorrow and suffering. There have been regrets, and times I cursed my fate...」

550:t_1:315.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Even so, I love this world, and I have no intention of allowing anyone to destroy it.」

550:t_1:317.en:
$$ゼロ$$
(That's right... Including the regrets that can never be undone, this is the present that leads to the future.)

550:t_1:318.en:
$$テッサ$$
「The key to $$レナード・テスタロッサ$$'s spacetime restoration is $$千鳥かなめ$$, whom you all know.」

550:t_1:319.en:
$$テッサ$$
「I have told you that she is a special being called a $$ウィスパード$$, but...」

550:t_1:320.en:
$$テッサ$$
「It is believed that her consciousness is now being taken over by what is called $$ウィスパリング$$, which sends information to those $$ウィスパード$$.」

550:t_1:321.en:
$$宗介$$
(So that's the truth behind $$千鳥$$'s transformation...)

550:t_1:322.en:
$$テッサ$$
「We will now head for $$メリダ島$$ and rescue $$カナメ$$ in order to stop $$レナード$$'s ambition.」

550:t_1:326.en:
$$テッサ$$
「With the battles against the Empire and $$ネオ・ジオン$$ still unsettled, we are taking on a battle for the sake of the world...」

550:t_1:327.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Even if we lose and $$レナード$$ carries out his spacetime restoration, it might only give rise to one more parallel world.」

550:t_1:328.en:
$$テッサ$$
「But I believe this: humanity must not go back to the past.」

550:t_1:329.en:
$$テッサ$$
「If doing so were ever allowed, it would mean the future loses its meaning.」

550:t_1:333.en:
$$マオ$$
「$$テッサ$$... Mind if I say something too?」
